verdict.rationale: Basecamp offers a first-party CLI for AI agents and a documented REST API (OpenAPI spec, OAuth, cURL examples, rate-limit Retry-After handling), so it can be driven programmatically without the web UI. Nothing in the evidence describes how to run the CLI non-interactively or in a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI usage, CI pipeline integration guidance (e.g. token-based auth for CI runners), and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
Throughout the Basecamp API docs, we include "Copy as cURL" examples.
Consult the `Retry-After` response header to determine how long to wait (in seconds) before retrying the request.
